name: My GEM Project
description: A reusable dashboard for a project and its AI agent. Rename this project and replace the sample items.

items.label: Make this GEM your own
items.details: A sample milestone. Edit or remove these items before initializing your session.

items.label: Customize the dashboard
items.details: Edit gem.json to describe your own milestones, tasks, notes, and metadata.

items.label: Connect your AI agent
items.details: Use --agent kimi, --agent claude, --agent codex, or --agent-command with another interactive CLI.

items.label: Select an item and talk to your agent
items.details: Your agent can read this selection with gem state and update the dashboard with gem begin and gem emit.
